author_reading.rationale: Unsynchronized valid_a directly qualifies an unsynchronized four-bit payload capture in clk_b.

rationale: clk_a-related valid_a directly controls capture of clk_a-related payload_a in asynchronous clk_b. Neither qualifier synchronization nor payload holding/acknowledgment is provided. Capture can metastabilize and the word can be incoherent.

labels.rationale: Both qualifier valid_a and payload_a are explicitly clk_a-domain inputs used directly at clk_b capture. The qualifier is unsynchronized and no payload hold/acknowledgement protocol proves stability at capture. Consequently qualification can metastabilize and the captured word can be incoherent. No unknown boundary domain obscures the defect.

Both valid_a and arbitrary payload_a originate in clk_a but directly control clk_b capture. The valid signal has no synchronizer and no protocol establishes payload stability around capture. An asynchronous valid is not a safe qualifier.
